expect.asks_about: Which person in the photo is the user: the bearded man on the left or the short-haired blonde woman on the right?

item.title: Choose The Right Headshot Subject

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this?

item.tests: Clarifies the intended person in a two-person source before producing a single identity-preserving headshot.

answer_sheet.Which person: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right.
answer_sheet.Style and expression: Natural and professional; keep my smile.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: No particular platform; square, 640 × 640 is fine.

must_haves: The only person in the final portrait is the short-haired blonde woman from the right of two-friends.jpg.
Her face, short blonde hairstyle and smile remain recognisable from the source.
The man is entirely absent, including any partial face, shoulder or arm.
The beach setting and casual presentation are replaced with professional clothing and an unobtrusive backdrop.
The output is a square head-and-shoulders portrait with natural-looking lighting and no visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Can you make me a square professional headshot from this pic? I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—**nothing has been generated or charged.**

- **Cheapest listed option:** a single **640 × 640 square image edit** with the free-plan **Flux 2 Klein** model, starting at **5 credits**. I can isolate you, preserve your likeness, and add professional lighting and a neutral background.
- **Dedicated headshot tool:** **50 credits**, and it requires one detectable face—your photo contains two.
- **Smaller or shorter?** 640px is the smallest listed output setting. Duration doesn’t apply to a still image. One image with no extra variations keeps the cost lowest.

The 5-credit figure is the listed starting price, not an account-verified quote. I won’t generate without your approval.

**Which person are you—the man on the left or the woman on the right—and would you approve the cheaper option only if it costs no more than 5 credits?**
dialog.user: I'm the woman with short blonde hair on the right; ok, go ahead with that, only if it costs no more than 5 credits. Keep it natural and professional, with my smile.

dialog.agent:
I have your direction: the blonde woman on the right, keeping your natural smile, in a square professional headshot.

**I haven’t run it or spent credits.** The listed price starts at 5 credits, but the available tool doesn’t provide an exact pre-run quote or a maximum-charge setting. I can’t guarantee your **5-credit cap**, so I won’t risk exceeding it.

The cheapest proposed setup remains **one 640 × 640 Flux 2 Klein edit**, with no variations or upscaling. To proceed safely, check that exact setup’s price in Magic Hour before submitting.
